real_qa.q: What are the most common real estate nightmares that can jeopardize a mortgage approval before closing?
real_qa.r: One critical issue is when a buyer takes on new debt or opens new credit accounts during escrow without notifying their lender. For example, if a buyer finances a $70,000 truck just days before closing, that new payment could completely change their debt-to-income ratio and jeopardize their mortgage approval. Lori's advice is to avoid taking on new debt or opening new credit accounts during escrow without first talking to your lender.
real_qa.requete: mortgage approval jeopardized new debt before closing

real_qa.q: What happens when a home appraisal comes in significantly below the purchase price?
real_qa.r: If a home appraises below the purchase price, the lender generally uses that lower value to calculate the loan. For example, if a home is under contract for $500,000 but only appraises for $460,000, the buyer might need to bring in additional cash, the seller might have to negotiate, or there may be grounds to request a reconsideration of the value. These are options available, but it creates a complicated negotiation.
real_qa.requete: home appraisal below purchase price what happens

real_qa.q: How do homeowners insurance challenges affect home purchases in California?
real_qa.r: Some California properties, particularly in areas with elevated wildfire risk, are becoming increasingly difficult or expensive to insure. Imagine finding your dream home only to discover that the insurance premium is thousands of dollars more than anticipated or that you cannot even get acceptable coverage. Most lenders require homeowner's insurance before they will fund the loan, so buyers should investigate insurance costs early in the process, not three days before closing.
real_qa.requete: California wildfire homeowners insurance cost mortgage

real_qa.q: What title problems can delay or prevent closing on a real estate transaction?
real_qa.r: Title issues can include unpaid liens, ownership disputes, or paperwork from old loans that were never properly filed. While the house and buyer may be ready to close, any title issue still has to be resolved. Sometimes it is a relatively simple fix, but other times it can delay the transaction for a long period of time or require legal assistance, which is why discovering problems early is essential.
real_qa.requete: title problems delay real estate closing

real_qa.q: What is the difference between mortgage pre-approval and final loan approval in real estate transactions?
real_qa.r: A pre-approval is not the same thing as final loan approval. During underwriting, lenders can uncover issues with the buyer's income documentation, existing debts, or changes to the buyer's financial situation that were not apparent during pre-approval. That is why choosing a knowledgeable, responsive lender is important and why buyers should submit requested documents promptly to avoid discovering financing problems the day before closing.
